Build is clean: exit 0, 0 errors.

The build was actually **failing**, not just noisy — it was crashing at the link stage, but the real error scrolled off past hundreds of harmless deprecation warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc., from Node/deps themselves — safe to ignore). Two real bugs from the bump, both in your code:

- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strictly required `true`/`false` for a flag, but the new config loader now leaves unset flags `undefined`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as `false` (disabled), matching old behavior.

Build now finishes with 0 errors (8 pre-existing deprecation warnings remain, which are informational only).
